config:
model:
  default: gb10-balanced
  provider: gb10-gateway
providers:
  gb10-gateway:
    api: http://192.168.10.62:8120/v1
    api_key: EMPTY
    default_model: gb10-balanced
    transport: chat_completions
fallback_providers: []
toolsets: [terminal, file]
platform_toolsets:
  cli: [terminal, file]
memory:
  memory_enabled: false
  user_profile_enabled: false
plugins:
  enabled: []
mcp_servers: {}
agent:
  reasoning_effort: none
  max_turns: 8
terminal:
  backend: local
compression:
  enabled: true
  threshold: 0.9
  protect_first_n: 0
  protect_last_n: 2
auxiliary:
  compression:
    provider: gb10-gateway
    model: gb10-balanced
telemetry:
  shared_metrics:
    enabled: false
    send: false
    offer_version: 2
onboarding:
  seen:
    profile_build_offered: true
